text:
sasha: FYI: late-night incident where a small subset of websocket clients hit a sticky resume loop after an edge proxy deploy. Clients kept resuming and getting a 409-like tombstone, then reconnecting. Token usage for those tenants shot up. anyone with context?

ethan: saw spike in reconnects + duplicate resumes, logs show resume_id collision with stale lease. Edge replayed old resume envelope during leader handover.

priya: when resume fails we currently send `resume_rejected` and immediately GC ephemeral KV. maybe we should back off GC to avoid clients re-requesting completions.

sasha: agree. quick mitigation: add short "post-resume cooloff" where we accept resumes but mark session provisional for 30s and avoid draining caches until control plane confirms session version. pseudocode:
```
if resume_failed and resume_age < 300s:
  session.state = provisional
  skip_kv_evict(30s)
```

ethan: sounds reasonable. telemetry suggestion: emit `ws_resume_provisional.v1` and `ws_resume_reject_counts.v1` by region so we can monitor.

ops-bot: metric emit: ws_resume_reject_counts=67 (3h), top region eu-west.

priya: rollout plan: 1) proxy accept-provisional behind flag, 2) quota estimator tweak to ignore single-session bursts tied to provisional marker, 3) dashboard panels + an alert if provisional>30/min for a region. canary eu-west 6h.

sasha: please include a cleanup task so provisional sessions older than 5m are force-validated; otherwise we leak state. also add a note for billing team.

ethan: I'll open PR for proxy flag + cleanup. priya can own quota change.

priya: will do. creating dashboard ticket and alert rule.

ops-bot: alert created: WS Provisional Surge (threshold=30/10m) -> #eng-platform-oncall.

sasha: thanks. keeping this light-touch. will post PR links. :white_check_mark:
